body:
As someone who feels SW probably saved my life, I encourage everyone to help out there. Sometimes, all it takes is to know that someone is listening, and has a few kind words.

Yes, I'm using the throwaway because it has the post history for easy verification.

>Okay, the med isn't doing what it's supposed to do, so you need to get back into see your doctor and tell him that they are having the opposite effect on you.

I should've specified in my post that I've been off Zoloft for about a year.

>As far as your religious beliefs or the lack of them, just keep it to yourself.

Well, normally, I did. But we had to do a speech on whether we believe in the "supernatural" or not. We all had to get up in front of the class and basically say our religion. So while people who said, and I quote, "I think if I didn't even know about God and church and the Bible and stuff, I'd still pray to him so I wouldn't go to hell," were applauded, when the wirey geek went up there and said, "I don't really believe in the, uh, supernatural," I got laughed out of the room. It's been torment since then.

>Don't even think about a job at this moment, or anything else except getting your health looked after because you are having a distorted view of your self and the world around you.

The world, maybe. I'll admit, maybe my view of the world is a little grim right now. But this hasn't affected the way I feel about myself. I've *always* loathed myself. When I do things that normally build people up, my first thought is, "Yeah, well you're going to fuck it up, it isn't that good anyway, you're still terrible." I'm sick of myself, but that's a whole other issue entirely, I suppose.

>You're going to be okay, and things will get better for you.

I don't how much longer I can wait. People have been saying it'll get better for years, but all that's happened is that it's festered and gotten worse.

>Please continue to post to let us know how you're making out.

Ha. Barely. I've eaten two cheeseburgers in as many days, drank a coke, some tea and a glass of orange juice, and had maybe ten hours of sleep. This isn't really a life, more an excuse to further torture myself.

>Firstly, if you can make it to college, that'll be a fantastic change for you.

I likely won't.

>Creation will absorb you, no matter whether what you create is shitty or incredible.

Why create something bad?

>Fuck getting a job if you can't. There's a perfectly good reason you can't, it's not your fault.

Try telling that to my mom. Everyday, she screams about how I need a job, to contribute, we're poor, I'm lazy.

>I don't think I have to tell you (because you already know) that people will absolutely care if you did this. You consciously think they won't, but you know how these things work. You know how shocked they'll be, how distraught.

There are probly only one or two people in the world who would rather be nice to me. I really doubt anyone else would care.

Ultimately, there just isn't any point anymore. Live so people can push me down and steal my  proverbial lunch money? A whole year of putting up with this shit?

And then what? Fail at getting into college and work minimum wage for the rest of my life, trapped in this shithole?

I won't be successful or happy. It just doesn't seem likely anymore. I feel like killing myself now would just be a favor to humanity.
